title: Values of global functions on etale field neighbourhoods are separable
statement: For a field $K$, let $\Omega$ be its algebraic closure and let $p$ be the geometric point of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For every etale $K$-scheme $X$, every lift $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$, and every global function $z$ on $X$, its evaluated value $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega)\cong\Omega$ is separable over $K$. The precise evaluation map is recorded in the Lean signature.

source.place: Tag 02G8 (finite separable residue extensions), as used in Example 03QV (2)

proof.text: Factor the lift through the residue field at its image. The base residue-field point is a surjective closed immersion into the reduced one-point scheme Spec K, so it is an isomorphism. Spec.preimage therefore yields a bijective map from K to that residue field. Compose it with the etale structural residue-field map. The source-library Scheme.Hom.etale_residueFieldMap, RingHom.Etale.of_bijective and stability under composition show the composite is etale, hence separable by Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_isSeparable.

The factorization of the lift and its equality over Spec K give that the final residue-field embedding into the algebraic closure is K-linear. Evaluate z in that residue field and apply IsSeparable.map to its injective algebra homomorphism. Scheme.GammaSpecIso_naturality identifies the image value with evaluation along the original lift (the Lean name is Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality).

lean.statement: theorem etale_evaluation_isSeparable (K : Type u) [Field K] : let Ω := AlgebraicClosure K let S := Spec (.of K) let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω))) ∀ (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X) (z : Γ(X.left, ⊤)), IsSeparable K ((ΓSpecIso (.of Ω)).hom (x.left.appTop z))
